description: Spin up an Ironbox: a secure sandbox next to Hyperliquid where an agent runs and trades, with Ironflow data, analytics, alerts and execution built in. Needs an API key (a free key works). It starts in state creating; get_ironbox shows when it is running.

markets.description: Hyperliquid markets the agent trades: perps, outcomes (HIP-4), spot

mode.description: paper (default) trades with simulated funds; live trades real funds

name.description: Name for the Ironbox, e.g. btc-funding-bot

note.description: Free text kept with the Ironbox, e.g. what the agent does

name: create_ironbox

dashboard.description: Where the user manages it on ironflow.sh

markets.description: Markets the agent trades: perps, outcomes, spot

message.description: What happens next, from the API

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

state.description: creating, running, stopped, deleted or error

title: Spin up an Ironbox
